title: AuthorizationRequest
description: Request body for the Choozle POST /api/auth endpoint. Field definitions transcribed from https://app.choozle.com/apidoc/api_data.json.

timestamp.description: Current datetime in ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2015-05-04T11:34:02-06:00. Must be within five minutes of the server's current time.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 digest, lowercase hex, of the concatenated email and timestamp, keyed with the API private key. Not uppercase hex and not base64.
